name: unidade-fast
description: FAST — North Police Department · Sistema de Gestão Operacional

scripts.build: npm run install:all && cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm run build
scripts.start: npm run build && cd backend && npm start
scripts.start:shardcloud: npm run build && cd backend && npm run start:shardcloud
scripts.testar:local: npm run build && cd backend && npm run testar:local
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.security: cd backend && npm run security && cd ../frontend && npm audit --audit-level=high
scripts.audit: cd backend && npm audit && cd ../frontend && npm audit
